subject: Expansion: Cedarline - add 2 projects & API keys (term addendum)
messages:
From: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@cedarlinehealth.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@cedarlinehealth.com
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700 (PDT)
Subject: Expanding to new apps — keys and capacity question

Hi Lauren,

We're planning to bring two additional internal teams onto Redwood in the next few months and I wanted to loop you in on requirements and timing. The two projects are:

- Patient Intake (customer-facing form flows, expected high concurrency during business hours)
- Claims Automation (batch/rule-based assistants used by ops)

Tentative targets: Patient Intake go-live ~June 15; Claims Automation ~July 20.

We need your guidance on:
1) Provisioning: can you issue separate API keys per project and per environment (prod/staging)?
2) Quotas & segregation: we want usage separated for billing and throttling.
3) Commercials: we estimate ~50M tokens/month across the two projects (rough split below). Is there a straightforward way to increase committed capacity mid-term and what would that look like on pricing?

Estimated split: Patient Intake ~30M/month; Claims Automation ~20M/month.

I've attached a quick scope workbook with high-level volumes and a tentative rollout calendar — please review. Also note our security/compliance team needs evidence of key governance processes and a completed SOC2 questionnaire by June 1 if we want Patient Intake to stay on the June 15 date.

Can we set a short call this week to align on provisioning and a commercial path? If you want, loop Marcus on pricing and Steph on rollout. Procurement is on copy to prep routing once we have a commercial.

Thanks,
Alice
Alice Johnson
Product Lead, Integrations
Cedarline Health
Attachment: Cedarline-Scope-APPS.xlsx

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@cedarlinehealth.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700 (PDT)
Subject: Re: Expanding to new apps — keys and capacity question

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear scope. This is doable and we can support separate keys and quota segmentation. Proposed next steps: 

1) Quick 30-min alignment call (I'll ping for availability) to confirm peak QPS and any per-endpoint rate limits.
2) I'll circulate a draft addendum & quote for the committed tokens increase (attached).
3) Stef will work with you on rollout milestones and security checklist deliverables so we hit your June 1 security gate.

A few questions to finalize the quote:
- Can you confirm peak QPS during business hours (estimate)?
- Do you want independent billing for each project or a single account-level bill with internal reporting?

Attachment: redwood-draft-quote-cedarline-v3.pdf

Draft API key naming convention we recommend (can change):
- cedarline-patientintake-prod
- cedarline-patientintake-staging
- cedarline-claims-prod
- cedarline-claims-staging

If that naming looks okay I'll ask Marcus to draft pricing options (one-off increase vs. commit bump + term addendum). Happy to hop on a call tomorrow morning.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

From: marcus_lin@redwood.com
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 13:22:00 -0700 (PDT)
Subject: Re: Expanding to new apps — keys and capacity question

Quick commercial note for the quote: for an incremental ~50M tokens/month baseline we can offer two paths:

A) Commit bump: increase monthly committed tokens to cover the new apps. Offer an 8% volume discount off current unit price if the customer signs a 6-month addendum to extend the committed term.
B) On-demand + provisioning fee: no change to term, on-demand usage billed at list with a one-time provisioning fee (we can waive this fee if they convert to a short-term commit within 60 days).

Recommended: Commit bump + 6-month addendum (option A). I'll prepare proposed redlined language for Addendum A: "Expand service scope to include two additional projects, increase committed monthly tokens to X, apply discount Y, effective date = date of signed addendum."

Steph — can you own the rollout plan with the Cedarline PMs and make sure the security questionnaire items are surfaced?

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@cedarlinehealth.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@cedarlinehealth.com
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 08:10:00 -0700 (PDT)
Subject: Re: Expanding to new apps — keys and capacity question

Thanks Lauren/Marcus — quick answers:
- Confirmed token split: Patient Intake 30M/month, Claims Automation 20M/month.
- Peak inference QPS: ~220 combined during morning peaks; steady background ~40 QPS.
- Billing: single account-level bill is preferred, but we need separate usage buckets for internal chargeback.
- Security: we'll need SOC2 evidence and a short runbook for key rotation.

We can accept a 6-month addendum if the unit price is reduced by 8% relative to current committed rate. We need contract routing to procurement@cedarlinehealth.com for signature.

Target rollout dates: Patient Intake -> June 15; Claims Automation -> July 20. Security sign-off must complete by June 1 for the June date.

Can you send the redlined addendum and a timeline that maps security tasks to milestones? Procurement is on copy for routing.

Cheers,
Alice
Alice Johnson
Product Lead, Integrations
Cedarline Health

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@cedarlinehealth.com>, marcus_lin@redwood.com, procurement@cedarlinehealth.com
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700 (PDT)
Subject: Re: Expanding to new apps — keys and capacity question

Alice — great, thanks for the numbers and timelines. Confirming next items and commitments from Redwood: 

1) Commercials: we will prepare Addendum A to increase committed tokens to 50,000,000/month (30M patient intake / 20M claims) and apply an 8% unit discount for a 6-month addendum as discussed. DocuSign link to follow.

2) Provisioning: separate API keys per project + environment. Keys will be created within 48 hours of executed addendum and scoped to usage buckets for chargeback. Naming convention we will use: cedarline-{project}-{env} (e.g., cedarline-patientintake-prod).

3) Security & Ops: Steph will deliver the SOC2 evidence pack and a short key-rotation runbook by May 25 to meet your June 1 gate. We'll provide a one-hour handover session for your security team.

4) Rollout timeline (high level):
- May 12: alignment call to confirm rate limits and endpoint patterns (I'll schedule).
- May 25: SOC2 evidence + key rotation runbook delivered.
- June 1: security sign-off target.
- June 15: Patient Intake cutover (prod key active).
- July 20: Claims Automation cutover (prod key active).

5) Procurement: Marcus will attach the redlined addendum. Procurement, please route the attached DocuSign when ready: https://docusign.com/link/abc123-rdw-cedarline

Attachments: redwood-draft-quote-cedarline-v3.pdf, Cedarline-Scope-APPS.xlsx

If that looks good I'll ask legal to issue the addendum and send DocuSign today so keys can be provisioned on receipt of signature.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
